recipes.title: Peanut Butter Chickpea Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C / 350°F and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Blend the chickpeas, peanut butter, honey, vanilla and baking powder in a food processor until it's a smooth, thick cookie dough.
Divide into 12 portions on the tray, then shape and slightly flatten each one.
Bake 15–20 minutes until lightly golden on top.
Let them cool before eating; they firm up as they cool.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros per cookie come from the video description. Use dairy-free chocolate chips to keep them fully plant-based.
